name: Babatunde Karimov
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Flux Karimov is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 43, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Flux Karimov plans to keep it that way. He works as a demolitions expert out of Geartown, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

he is not the most talented demolitions expert in GLMZ, but he might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Ximena Morita-Antwi witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Ximena Morita-Antwi owes a personal debt to
A Tier 4 executive offers Ximena Morita-Antwi a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
The fixer who handles Ximena Morita-Antwi's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Ximena Morita-Antwi functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Complex multi-continental blend reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: Central Asian foundation (34.2%) provides moderate bone structure and mid-range skin base, layered with Southeast Asian genetics (30.3%) contributing warm golden undertones and subtle epicanthal eye characteristics. Sub-Saharan African ancestry (15.8%) deepens overall skin richness, broadens nasal structure, and adds fullness to lips. South Asian genetics (14.8%) enhance cheekbone definition and warm undertone luminosity. Eastern European trace (4.9%) contributes minimal phenotypic influence. The result is a warm, complexly-toned appearance where no single heritage dominates—instead they blend into a distinctly cosmopolitan physical presence.
physical_description.build: Stocky and densely muscled — barrel-chested with thick shoulders and forearms. Years of handling explosives and structural demolition work have built functional mass rather than aesthetic bulk. Solid, immovable center of gravity.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with grey threading at temples
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown — unaugmented, but carries the flat focus of someone who has learned to see past surfaces
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze with complex undertones—Central Asian moderate base enriched by Southeast Asian golden warmth, deepened and enriched by Sub-Saharan African and South Asian contributions. Sun-weathered darker at neck and forearms creating natural gradient. Skin carries luminosity and richness rather than grey or cool cast. Overall appearance suggests someone whose ancestry draws from multiple warm-climate populations.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lived-in with character lines earned over decades. Creases at corners of eyes and mouth from squinting and controlled expressions. Jaw set with habitual tension. Skin shows minor scarring from accumulated work hazards. Stubble usually present—pragmatic neglect rather than styling choice. Facial structure shows synthesis of Central and Southeast Asian bone geometry with broader nasal structure influenced by Sub-Saharan and South Asian ancestry. Cheekbones defined without harshness. Overall face reads as approachable through familiarity rather than softness.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 8cm across his left cheekbone, slightly deeper at the center — old burn or shrapnel wound, healed well but visible
Cluster of three small circular scars on inside of left wrist, arranged vertically — removed augmentation ports or deliberate erasure marks
Burn scarring across the knuckles of both hands — old, faded, consistent with explosive work
Faint tattoo on right shoulder blade: abstract geometric pattern, style suggests pre-GLMZ origin, possibly from a previous life
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome smartgun link integrated into right forearm — visible as a polished steel interface port at the wrist, subtle cable articulation along the ulna. The augmentation is clean and maintained but deliberately unconcealed. Cyberears visible as brushed titanium housing behind both ears, slightly larger than biological ears, with small directional microphone arrays at 2 o'clock and 8 o'clock positions.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight centered, ready to shift direction instantly. Hands at rest but never fully relaxed, fingers occasionally flexing as if testing resistance. When walking, moves like someone navigating a space already mapped by risk assessment. Eye contact is minimal but deliberate when engaged.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear. Usually canvas work pants in dark grey or black, reinforced at stress points, numerous cargo pockets. Heavy-duty boots — always tied tight, always ready to move. Shirt varies: grey or charcoal compression-weave undershirt, sometimes layered with a worn Geartown fabricator's jacket in faded black synth-leather. No corporate logos. No unnecessary ornamentation. Everything is utilitarian and maintained to function. Gear: heavy webbing harness worn over jackets, ammunition pouches, tool belt. A long canvas coat for weather — pockets deep enough for detonators and circuit boards.

image_prompt: Flux Karimov, seasoned demolitions expert, 173cm stocky build with dense muscle from years of explosive work. Deep warm bronze skin with complex undertones blending Central Asian, Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian heritage—golden warmth with luminous richness. Dark brown eyes with hard-earned focus. Short military-cropped dark hair greying at temples. Weathered face with creases from decades of squinting, thin white scar across left cheekbone, burn scars on knuckles. Brushed titanium cyberears visible, chrome smartgun link interface at right wrist. Wearing reinforced dark grey canvas work pants, heavy boots, grey compression-weave undershirt under faded black synth-leather fabricator's jacket. Heavy webbing harness with ammunition pouches. Economic, precise posture—weight centered and ready. Dimly-lit industrial compound setting at dusk, harsh overhead lighting cutting sharp shadows across weathered features. GLMZ, gritty utilitarian aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
